buyer_job: Compare current retailer offers and wait for a target price
scarce_asset: merchant coverage; product matching; offer history
observed_evidence: claimed 500m-plus offers and about 50000 retailers; twelve-month history; alerts; payment-independent organic ranking
what_works: fresh offer graph plus a recurrence loop
pressure_or_limit: offer accuracy; platform competition; low published CPC
founder_read: Price alone becomes more useful when history and alerts turn a one-off visit into retained intent

buyer_job: Compare products prices reviews tests payment and delivery
scarce_asset: comparison brand; structured catalogue; high-intent traffic
revenue_layers: merchant traffic; strategic value inside Klarna
observed_evidence: acquired by Klarna for SEK 4.617bn consideration; Klarna reports 13 Search and Compare markets plus 100m-plus products and 500m-plus listings; court later awarded damages over search self-preferencing
evidence_class: regulatory filing plus court and company announcements
what_works: rich comparison embedded into a larger shopping and payments system
pressure_or_limit: search gatekeeper dependence; award not final
founder_read: Distribution power is valuable but cannot be treated as neutral or permanent

buyer_job: Compare transparent prices and product information
scarce_asset: price history; merchant breadth; recognised local brands
observed_evidence: multiple country brands including PriceSpy in the UK
what_works: local brand plus price transparency
pressure_or_limit: no public segment economics; horizontal platform pressure
founder_read: A mature price engine is an operating system for data freshness rather than a catalogue launch

buyer_job: Find products and send high-intent traffic to merchants
scarce_asset: feed infrastructure; publisher distribution; campaign operation
observed_evidence: owned comparison sites plus Google Shopping ads and a publisher network across 29 claimed markets
what_works: evolved from destination into multi-surface merchant distribution
pressure_or_limit: merchant value is tied to measurable traffic quality
founder_read: A comparison engine can survive by becoming infrastructure but that is a different company from an editorial brand

buyer_job: Compare product offers inside search and shopping surfaces
scarce_asset: default search distribution; merchant feeds; product graph
observed_evidence: product and merchant-listing surfaces plus direct structured-data and feed routes
what_works: distribution and merchant data at global scale
pressure_or_limit: sets the baseline that a startup cannot beat on breadth
founder_read: Do not build a weaker Google Shopping; own evidence or constraints Google lacks

buyer_job: Inspect price and offer history and trigger alerts
scarce_asset: longitudinal Amazon data; API; seller graph
observed_evidence: API exposes histories offers deals sellers tracking and product-finder queries
what_works: turns volatile marketplace data into queryable infrastructure
pressure_or_limit: concentrated Amazon dependency and paid-token economics
founder_read: Historical data can be sold as infrastructure when its time series is costly to recreate

buyer_job: See Amazon price history and receive a price-drop alert
scarce_asset: long-lived history; simple alert utility
observed_evidence: free price tracker with history alerts and Amazon affiliate links
what_works: one legible recurring job executed simply
pressure_or_limit: Amazon content and affiliate dependency are explicit
founder_read: A narrow retained utility can outlast generic editorial but platform concentration remains existential

buyer_job: Match a phone variant to budget specifications local stores and radio bands
scarce_asset: variant-aware phone graph; dense filters; compatibility data
observed_evidence: 62 visible filters and prices from more than 100 claimed stores
what_works: category-specific identity and compatibility rules
pressure_or_limit: cross-border variants and store suitability require verification
founder_read: The category schema is the product; price comparison is an attached transaction layer

buyer_job: Assemble a compatible PC and buy each component well
scarce_asset: compatibility graph; complete bill of materials; community builds; price history
observed_evidence: automatic compatibility guidance multi-retailer prices histories alerts completed builds and forums
what_works: solves a whole project whose parts must work together
pressure_or_limit: compatibility errors and retailer dependence are undisclosed
founder_read: Closest analogue to the recommended decision company because the saved project is more valuable than any product page

buyer_job: Choose products using independent comparative evidence
scarce_asset: brand trust; test methods; member base; endorsement mark
observed_evidence: 500063 memberships at June 2025 down 4.1 percent; 3390 products tested in the year
what_works: independence funded by several aligned layers and disciplined test selection
pressure_or_limit: membership pressure and the cost of more than 100 categories
founder_read: Testing is a portfolio allocation problem; stopping weak categories is part of quality

buyer_job: Make product and service decisions using independent tests
scarce_asset: laboratories; member trust; advocacy; long-run data
observed_evidence: expects more than $30m to test and rate over 10000 products and services
what_works: institutional capital makes costly observation credible
pressure_or_limit: economics and scale are unreachable for a new publisher
founder_read: Original testing is defensible precisely because it is expensive; start where one method can change a purchase

buyer_job: Compare measured performance across electronics and appliances
scarce_asset: versioned test benches; retained products; lab; measurement history
observed_evidence: 4870 claimed products bought and tested; approximately 40000 square feet of laboratory space; 28 membership categories
what_works: public methods retained calibration products and retesting create a compounding evidence graph
pressure_or_limit: full results moving behind membership may narrow top-of-funnel access
founder_read: The moat is not prose but reproducible measurements with version and correction history

buyer_job: Choose outdoor equipment from side-by-side real-world tests
scarce_asset: field protocols; category experts; calibration products
observed_evidence: buys tested products at retail; no ads sponsored content or free test units
what_works: high-intent tests align directly to affiliate transactions
pressure_or_limit: affiliate-only funding concentrates attribution and traffic risk
founder_read: A focused protocol can fund itself but needs distribution resilience beyond search

buyer_job: Choose technology home sleep and wellness products
scarce_asset: standardised test methods; specialist editors; archive
revenue_layers: affiliate commission; advertising and endorsement staff disclosed
observed_evidence: hands-on methods include standardised battery and mattress tests; affiliate links fund free access
what_works: repeatable methods turn editorial claims into comparable records
pressure_or_limit: commercial teams and category expansion require strong separation controls
founder_read: Publish the method and result fields; the article should interpret the database

buyer_job: Choose and use technology home and wellness products
scarce_asset: brand distribution; lab and real-world protocols; editorial team
observed_evidence: category benchmarks hands-on use explicit ratings and product-finder expansion
what_works: large editorial surface backed by explicit test protocols
pressure_or_limit: parent results show session and affiliate exposure at portfolio level
founder_read: Scale is not insulation from discovery change; direct audience and data still matter

buyer_job: Choose household products backed by laboratory and expert review
scarce_asset: century-old trust; laboratories; Seal and warranty
observed_evidence: seven testing spaces; affiliate disclosure; Seal includes a limited two-year warranty on qualifying products
what_works: a trusted mark can become a product with liability and enforcement behind it
pressure_or_limit: warranty and licensing add operational and reputational exposure
founder_read: A badge is defensible only when the operator can stand behind it

buyer_job: Discover expert product advice across many vertical brands
scarce_asset: brand portfolio; audience data; editorial operations; advertiser access
revenue_layers: affiliate; advertising; subscriptions; events; leads; data and services
observed_evidence: 2025 Signal Future+ and Collab initiatives target social email creator and direct-member distribution
what_works: revenue and distribution portfolio rather than one affiliate surface
pressure_or_limit: HY2026 reported revenue down 8 percent and session-linked exposure remains
founder_read: Diversification is an operating necessity not a decorative revenue slide

system_type: vertical vehicle marketplace and dealer system
buyer_job: Search compare finance and transact around vehicles
scarce_asset: consumer demand; live stock; retailer relationships; pricing data; workflow software
revenue_layers: dealer subscriptions; listings; manufacturer and consumer services
observed_evidence: 13942 average retailer forecourts and 2995 pounds average monthly retailer revenue in FY2026
what_works: supplier subscriptions expand as the marketplace enters dealer workflow
pressure_or_limit: automotive density and data are not transferable to a new equipment market
founder_read: Marketplace leverage comes after demand; workflow software makes it harder for supply to leave

buyer_job: Compare vehicle value and contact dealers
scarce_asset: deal rating; traffic; dealer leads; market data
observed_evidence: dealer listing packages remain active while CarOffer transaction operations were wound down in 2025
what_works: information and lead products fit the marketplace asset
pressure_or_limit: owned transaction execution produced impairments and wind-down cost
founder_read: Adjacency is not strategy: keep the capital-light decision layer until transaction control proves superior

buyer_job: Find value and trade new used and vintage instruments
scarce_asset: category community; specialist inventory; transaction trust
revenue_layers: seller fee; payment processing; advertising and creator adjacency
observed_evidence: current seller fee is 5 percent; sold by Etsy in 2025 and continues standalone
what_works: specialist identity and liquidity survived a change of owner
pressure_or_limit: portfolio fit and parent valuation are separate from product usefulness
founder_read: A coherent vertical marketplace can remain valuable even when a strategic owner reverses course

buyer_job: Buy or sell watches across borders with reduced trust risk
scarce_asset: dealer verification; escrow; proof of ownership; authentication operations
revenue_layers: transaction fee and dealer services not fully observed
observed_evidence: claimed 9m monthly visitors 671000 listings and 58000 sellers plus escrow and buyer protection
what_works: trust operations make geographically broad high-value inventory transact
pressure_or_limit: fraud loss service cost and take rate are undisclosed
founder_read: For expensive heterogeneous goods the secret sauce is transaction assurance rather than content volume

buyer_job: Find industrial agricultural and construction equipment
scarce_asset: dealer inventory graph; vertical search; dealer-management software
revenue_layers: dealer listing and software revenue; parent marketplace adjacency
observed_evidence: claimed millions of buyers and 3000-plus verified dealers; acquired by Liquidity Services in 2018
what_works: search demand and supplier tooling reinforce one another
pressure_or_limit: inventory freshness and country-level liquidity are unknown
founder_read: Land equipment should follow this seller-tools-plus-search pattern rather than a boxed-product feed

buyer_job: Find equipment and monitor wanted inventory
scarce_asset: dealer network; detailed equipment schema; print and digital distribution
revenue_layers: dealer advertising; websites; ecommerce; auctions; featured listings
observed_evidence: saved searches alerts valuations want-to-buy and dealer inventory services are live
what_works: deep seller services support the discovery marketplace
pressure_or_limit: UK dealer economics and liquidity are unproven
founder_read: The data model must understand condition hours location transport and service not merely SKU

buyer_job: Find and list compact construction equipment
scarce_asset: focused UK inventory and seller access
observed_evidence: live paid listing tiers for private sellers and dealers
what_works: legible monetisation for heterogeneous used assets
pressure_or_limit: transaction volume and lead outcomes are undisclosed
founder_read: A narrow classified can charge supply before it builds a full transaction layer

system_type: parts catalogue marketplace and design system
buyer_job: Identify source design and buy exact parts or sets
scarce_asset: community-maintained catalogue; part relationships; wanted lists; Studio software
observed_evidence: 10000-plus claimed sellers 1m-plus members and a catalogue joining sets parts inventories and price history
what_works: identity graph plus bill of materials plus creation tool creates repeated utility
pressure_or_limit: community governance and dependence on one manufacturer ecosystem
founder_read: The saved design and exact component graph are a stronger moat than listings alone

buyer_job: Identify a specific release and buy or sell it
scarce_asset: community-built canonical release graph; collection and Wantlist
observed_evidence: every visible database field is user-entered; marketplace listings attach to release identity
what_works: collector labour builds a catalogue no merchant feed contains
pressure_or_limit: seller pre-screening and transaction guarantees are explicitly limited
founder_read: Community contribution works when contributors receive collection identity and market utility

buyer_job: Buy the exact printing condition and language of a card
scarce_asset: canonical card graph; seller liquidity; trustee service; API
observed_evidence: listings attach to correct product pages and eligible payments are held until receipt
what_works: identity precision and escrow reduce an otherwise chaotic trade
pressure_or_limit: liquidity and loss rates vary by game and remain undisclosed
founder_read: Canonical identity and payment controls can be the full product in a collectible market

buyer_job: Move from inspiration to professional project delivery
scarce_asset: project imagery; professional graph; workflow software
observed_evidence: Houzz Pro is sold as paid workflow software while Shop Houzz is operated by a Cart.com entity under licence
what_works: professional workflow monetises the supply side beyond product discovery
pressure_or_limit: commerce fulfilment has been structurally separated from the core platform
founder_read: In installed home categories the durable layer may be project and supplier workflow not merchant-of-record commerce

buyer_job: Choose and purchase a robotic mower from one brand
scarce_asset: product expertise; installation and brand inventory
revenue_layers: direct product margin; affiliate partner distribution
observed_evidence: affiliate page states 1000-pound-plus AOV 5-percent-plus commission and 30-day cookie
what_works: economics and product knowledge sit close to checkout
pressure_or_limit: cannot provide neutral cross-brand comparison
founder_read: The aggregator must solve cross-brand suitability or the manufacturer can own the decision

buyer_job: Choose and purchase high-ticket sauna spa and wellness equipment
scarce_asset: specialist assortment; fulfilment; product service
observed_evidence: merchant reports 2000-to-5000-pound average order across high-ticket categories
what_works: high-order-value retailer can fund meaningful referral commission
pressure_or_limit: one retailer's range and disclosures are commercially interested
founder_read: A publisher needs multiple merchants and post-sale context to add value

buyer_job: Choose and buy garden buildings
scarce_asset: inventory; delivery; category content
observed_evidence: live affiliate terms show 1.5 percent commission and exclusion of finance orders
what_works: direct fulfilment and content can capture the whole journey
pressure_or_limit: low commission and finance exclusions weaken publisher economics
founder_read: Nominal category AOV is irrelevant if important transaction paths do not attribute

buyer_job: Plan and buy premium games-room products
scarce_asset: showroom; specialist advice; delivery and installation
observed_evidence: merchant reports about 1400-pound AOV 5 percent commission and a 30-day cookie
what_works: coherent room-level assortment supports cross-sell and service
pressure_or_limit: PPC restrictions validation and merchant concentration constrain a publisher
founder_read: A neutral room planner must outperform the retailer's own advice without owning fulfilment

buyer_job: Source premium new vintage and restored games-room equipment
scarce_asset: rare stock; restoration expertise; service
observed_evidence: live range spans billiards football tables jukeboxes pinball and related service
what_works: scarce inventory and craft expertise create authority
pressure_or_limit: no observed publisher referral economics
founder_read: Some high-value categories reward owning supply and restoration more than aggregating links

buyer_job: Specify a safe compatible ceramics studio
scarce_asset: category expertise; bundles; support; stocked equipment
observed_evidence: live 1199-pound wheel package and 4833-pound kiln-and-wheel studio bundle plus buying guidance
what_works: bundles translate technical constraints into a complete purchase
pressure_or_limit: retailer advice is limited to stocked assortment
founder_read: The aggregator needs multi-brand compatibility data and owned tests to beat a good specialist merchant

system_type: specialist ceramics retailer with comparison content
buyer_job: Compare pottery wheels and buy from a specialist
scarce_asset: category expertise; guide-led merchandising
observed_evidence: live 2026 wheel guide compares products sold by the retailer
what_works: decision content sits directly beside checkout
pressure_or_limit: selection and ranking can favour owned inventory
founder_read: Retailer content validates the decision job but not an independent publisher moat

buyer_job: Research and buy workshop machinery and tools
scarce_asset: large assortment; stores; trade brand
observed_evidence: affiliate page states more than 21000 products 2 percent commission and whole-site AOV above 100 pounds
what_works: assortment breadth and physical retail support fulfilment
pressure_or_limit: whole-site AOV is far below the research target and broad catalogue dilutes identity
founder_read: A maker aggregator should curate project systems rather than mirror a general tool shop

buyer_job: Access merchant programmes product data tracking and payment
scarce_asset: advertiser network; feeds; transaction records; payment rails
observed_evidence: feeds expose millions of product details and are used by price-comparison publishers
what_works: removes integration and settlement work for new publishers
pressure_or_limit: same infrastructure is available to competitors and attribution can leak
founder_read: A feed is rented infrastructure; retained identity and outcomes must live in the publisher's own system

buyer_job: Compare regulated financial products and switch
scarce_asset: consumer demand; provider panel; decision data; regulated process
revenue_layers: click fee; commission; tenancy; insight; white-label
observed_evidence: public model combines click purchase and sponsored fees; annual report describes data insight and white-label services
what_works: transaction intent becomes provider media data and embedded tools
pressure_or_limit: regulated finance differs materially from physical products
founder_read: The transferable lesson is revenue sequencing after demand and decision data exist

buyer_job: Describe a need and compare products conversationally
scarce_asset: model interface; user intent; direct merchant feeds
revenue_layers: platform and merchant value model unsettled
observed_evidence: merchant feeds and retailer integrations support product discovery and merchant checkout direction
what_works: compresses intent capture synthesis and routing into one interface
pressure_or_limit: UK adoption attribution and publisher compensation are unknown
founder_read: Assume machines will consume the catalogue; charge for evidence or transactions the machine cannot originate

buyer_job: Discover compare finance and complete shopping in one ecosystem
scarce_asset: payments relationship; app distribution; PriceRunner data
observed_evidence: Klarna says PriceRunner adds product discovery comparisons reviews and high-intent merchant traffic and powers a Shopping Search app in ChatGPT
what_works: comparison data gains value when attached to checkout and an existing consumer relationship
pressure_or_limit: integration value and standalone PriceRunner economics are not separately disclosed
founder_read: The strategic buyer values aggregation as intent infrastructure not merely affiliate pages
